statement: test_original_response_with_broken_headers hands ._extract_http_info an object whose .headers property raises, but the function's source-locating loop treats every truthy .headers as list-like so the property is never probed; the test cannot fail and its retry assertion is unreachable. Removed in this pass.

test_exception_without_headers_attr passes a plain Exception as kwargs['exception'], which lacks .status_code, so ._extract_http_info's input-locating loop rejects it before any extraction runs; the None assertion tests the rejection branch rather than a missing .headers path. Removed in this pass.

Module-export hasattr tests assert a name exists after import, which only passes if the import itself emitted the name; a renamed export is more likely to fail at registration than to be caught by this assertion. Returns nothing about behavior.
